title: Concept: Object reconstruction via jsonpickle.decode (python) — review required
description: In python, jsonpickle.decode treats the document as a description of objects rather than plain data. A crafted payload can name any importable class and drive its reconstructor, so decoding alone can execute code or mutate global state. The safe boundary is a data-only parser plus an explicit mapping step.
applicability: python services that decode documents arriving from queues, uploads, or peer services.
risk: Code execution and object-graph injection during decode; HIGH severity.
